[SWS_FrArTp_00256] ⌈To achieve an even distribution of PDUs to all currently trans-
mitting and/or receiving connections associated with a PDU pool, the PDUs of this
pool shall be assigned to active connections using round robin scheduling. A connec-
tion that is currently receiving and transmitting may claim two PDUs in one round of the
assignment: one for the FC, and one for an SF/FF/CF.⌋
